title: Computer Graphics: Main Exam, 10 December 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS.

parts.text: Discuss the role of Graphical User Interface in adoption of computer usage.
Discuss the two methods used to generate colour on a raster scan system.
Explain how light sources can be classified and give an example in each category.
Using an illustration only, show the general three-dimensional viewing pipeline and the coordinates used in it.
Show the output of the following monochrome image file: 4,4,1010101010101010
List the three distinct differences between the 2D and 3D viewing pipelines.
Outline ALL parameters that can be used to measure the performance of computer monitors.
Define the term clipping and explain how to achieve polygon clipping.
Distinguish between boundary representation and space-partitioning representation as they apply to object modelling.
Outline the advantages of the CRT screen.
In memory mapping, differentiate between peeking and poking.
List the steps of Bresenham's line drawing algorithm, including all the formulae for calculating the decision parameters.
Identify the OpenGL routines that can be used to create a rectangle.
Identify and describe the two methods used in inside-outside testing of fill areas.
Identify two algorithms that may be used to generate pixels for a line element.
Differentiate between the Digital Differential Analyzer line drawing algorithm and Bresenham's line drawing algorithm.
Discuss any two types of line clipping algorithms.
